title: feat(app-shell): the Studio Changes badge and the item header follow the copilot's drafts as they land (objectui#12725, part)
body:
Part of #12725
Clause-②: no

## What changes

Phase 5 of objectui#12725 takes two remainder items of the card: item 5 (the 变更 badge counts the copilot's drafts the moment they land; the item header shows 「草稿 · N 项未发布」) and item 3's marks (the 草稿 chip and the 来源 line), which were measured first and are **not drawn** (below).

- **The badge re-reads as the copilot's `drafted` result lands, not when the turn ends.** `ChatPane` (the chat host the Studio copilot mounts) announces each tool result that carries an authoring envelope (`draftReview`, or a 确认修改 replay's `replayOutcome`) on the assistant bus (`emitMetadataRefresh`) the moment it appears in the stream. Each result is announced once, keyed by its message and its position in that message; the results already in the thread when the pane mounts are history and are not announced. No reload, no navigation: the badge's own ledger (`usePendingDrafts`, `GET /meta/_drafts`) already re-read on that pulse.
- **The item header shows 「草稿 · N 项未发布」** (en "Draft · N unpublished") on the Interfaces, Data and Automations pillars while the open item is a pending draft, in place of the "Unpublished draft" chip. It reads the ledger the badge counts (new `studioItemDraftStatus.ts`, provided by the surface to its pillars), so a draft the copilot writes to the open item shows as it lands, and the line goes when a publish or a discard takes the item off the ledger. N is the badge's number: publishing is package-level, so the line says this item is one of N unpublished changes, and its tooltip says that. The pillar's own reading of its item (taken at load) counts only while the ledger is behind a Studio save (objectui#11787's `behindSave`); where the ledger could not be read, the header keeps the old chip with no count.
- Two new rows in the Studio designer table (en, zh): `engine.studio.itemDraftPending`, `engine.studio.itemDraftPendingTitle`.

## The measured chain (before this change, at `32b492b6`)

- **What the badge reads:** `StudioDesignSurface` holds `usePendingDrafts({ packageId })`, whose `fetchPendingDrafts` reads `GET /api/v1/meta/_drafts?packageId=…`, the route the framework's `listDrafts` serves. The count is the row count (`shownPendingCount`, at least one while `behindSave`). The cloud envelope's `draftState` is read from the same `listDrafts` server-side (cloud `f9e45145`, `readDraftState` in `change-posture.ts`).
- **When it re-reads:** on mount; on `publishNonce`; on a Studio draft save (`onDraftSaved` → `refresh({ afterSave: true })`); and on the assistant bus's pulse, which `usePendingDrafts` subscribes to (`subscribeMetadataRefresh`).
- **Who sends the pulse for a copilot result:** only `ChatPane`, in the effect commented "objectui#5801 — when a turn that STAGED or PUBLISHED something finishes": it returned early while `isLoading`, and read the last assistant message only. So a `drafted` result reached the badge only when the stream finished, after the agent's whole narration.
- **The seam.** The Studio copilot is `StudioChatDock` → `StudioCopilotConversation` → `ChatPane`; `ChatPane` owns the stream (`useObjectChat`) and is the only host-side holder of the tool results. `ChatDock.tsx` is the console's own dock, not Studio's. The callback the chat already exposes to its host, `ChatbotEnhanced`'s `onDraftArtifacts`, is not enough: it fires only when the cumulative `type:name` set grows (a second change to the same item, or one after a publish, never fires it), and `mapMessages` suppresses `draftReview` on a confirm-replay (`replayOutcome ? undefined : detectDraftResult(result)`), so the 确认修改 path, the one cloud#2924's draft posture goes through, never reaches it. The change therefore lives in `ChatPane`'s own effect (`AiChatPage.tsx`); `ChatbotEnhanced.tsx` and `mapMessages.ts` are untouched.
- **The header before:** each pillar's chip read its own `hasDraft`, taken once when the item loads and set by its own save, and not re-read on the pulse; an `object` leaf on Interfaces carries none. A copilot draft to the open item never marked its header (live reading below).

## Item 3, the 草稿 chip and the 来源 line: measured, not drawn

No declared key carries per-field draft provenance (who drafted it, from which surface, when), so nothing is drawn for item 3, and nothing is inferred from timing or from "the last tool call touched this field".

- **The framework's draft rows** (pin `be076dad28a0`): `ListDraftsResponseSchema` (`packages/spec/src/api/protocol.zod.ts`) declares, per draft row, `type`, `name`, `member`, `label`, `packageId`, `updatedAt` and `updatedBy`. Those are per ITEM, not per field. `SysMetadataRepository.listDrafts` fills `updatedBy` from `row.updated_by ?? row.created_by`, the acting user; the copilot stages with that same user as `actor` (cloud `stageDraft` passes `input.actor`, which the tools set from `exec?.actor?.id`), so a copilot draft and the user's own hand edit carry the same `updatedBy`. `sys_metadata`'s `source` column (`filesystem | database | api | migration`) is storage origin, and `listDrafts` does not project it.
- **The copilot's envelopes** (cloud `f9e45145`, `applyDraft` and `describeLandedChange` in `metadata-tools.ts`): `status`, `type`, `name`, `packageId`, `summary`, `changedKeys`, `note`, then `posture`, `draftState` (`pending`, `items` as `type`/`name`, `others`), `existingRows` and `appliedCard`. `changedKeys` names the keys one call wrote, in the conversation only: it carries no time, is not stored with the draft, and is not true any more once the user or a later call edits the same key. Drawing the chip from it is exactly the "last tool call touched this field" inference the dispatch rules out.
- The producer card this needs is in the report's out-of-scope findings.

## Tests

- New `StudioDesignSurface.copilotDraftBadge-12725.test.tsx` (5): the real surface, top bar, `usePendingDrafts`, right slot and Studio copilot (`StudioChatDock` → `StudioCopilotConversation` → `ChatPane`), the chat package's own `uiMessagesToChatMessages` fed the producer's envelope shapes; the transport plays a scripted stream. (1) a `drafted` `apply_edit` result re-reads the badge to 2 while the turn is still running, with the same surface tree and location; (2) a 确认修改 replay (`replay_…` id) does the same; (3) each result is announced once, later chunks and the turn's end send no second pulse; (4) CONTROL: a read tool's result sends no pulse; (5) a drafted result already in the thread at mount is history, not announced.
- New `StudioDesignSurface.itemDraftLine-12725.test.tsx` (4): the Data pillar's header shows the line with the badge's number as the copilot's draft lands; gone after a publish (the surface's own `doPublish`); gone after a discard takes the item off the ledger; CONTROL: another item's draft is counted by the badge and marks no header.
- New `__tests__/studioItemDraftStatus-12725.test.ts` (7): the derivation rules one by one (listed, stored-type fold, absent, a stale own reading, the `behindSave` bridge, no ledger, no item).
- **Before** (base `32b492b6` sources checked out over the committed tests, restored by `git checkout HEAD`, blobs equal to HEAD and `git diff HEAD` empty): 7 red, 2 green (the two CONTROL cases). Red: the three landing cases (no pulse while the turn runs), the history case (the base announced a hydrated thread's last authoring turn on mount: 1 pulse), and the three header-line cases (the header never shows the copilot's draft).
- **Ablation** (an isolated worktree at `111d6816`, through objectstack's `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` in wrap mode; no dist step, the tests import app-shell src relatively): A1, ChatPane's `if (landed) emitMetadataRefresh();` replaced by `void landed;`: 3 red (the three landing cases), the CONTROL and the history case green; restored, blob == HEAD (`ad1d0a6041b1`) and `git diff HEAD` empty. A2, the header line's `if (!listed && !(ownDraft && pending.behindSave)) return undefined;` replaced by `if (!ownDraft) return undefined;` (the pillar's own reading only, the old source): 6 red (the three header-line cases, three derivation cases), 5 green; restored, blob == HEAD (`6c981c2758f8`) and `git diff HEAD` empty.
- **Full package** `vitest run packages/app-shell/` (the package script's command) at `111d6816`, in 8 `--shard` runs under the verify lock (one run exceeds the 10-minute foreground cap), each EXIT 0: 1568 files run (1567 passed, 1 skipped) of 1568 tracked test files; 14740 tests passed, 9 skipped. After merging `origin/main` (`0707b4ae`, which brought objectui#12724's `mapMessages` and `ChatbotEnhanced` changes) at `a2326866`: the new files plus `console/ai/__tests__`, `studio-design/__tests__`, `layout`, `preview` and the six surface files that read the badge or the status chip, 176 files / 1118 tests, EXIT 0. The whole package was not re-run after the merge; that run is CI's.

## Gates

Local, exit codes captured before any pipe.

- `pnpm --filter '@object-ui/app-shell^...' build`: VERDICT command-exit 0, at `111d6816` and again at `a2326866`.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell type-check` (`tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`): EXIT 0, 0 `error TS`, at `b151ed07` and at `a2326866`; the test project lists all three new test files (`--listFilesOnly`).
- `eslint` on the seven changed files: 0 errors; warnings per file unchanged against the base (`AiChatPage.tsx` 34, `StudioDesignSurface.tsx` 13, `i18n.ts` 0); the new files 0.
- EXIT 0 at `a2326866`: `check:i18n-keys`, `check:i18n-drift`, `check:i18n-designer-parity`, `check:new-line-citations` (0 new), `check:control-bytes`, `check:test-path-roots`, `check:vi-mock-specifiers`, `check:vi-mock-inherit`, `check:vi-mock-override-shape`, `check:changeset-claims`, `changeset:check`, `scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs` (7 source files of 1 released package, 1 changeset). EXIT 0 at `111d6816`: `check:i18n-dead-keys` (report-only; the two new keys are not among its candidates), `check:pending-changeset-literals`, `check:spec-symbols`, `check:phantom-deps`, `check:self-import`, `check:esm-specifiers`, `check:unreferenced-sources`, `check:handler-key-reads`, `check:metadata-write-doors`, `check:comment-mask-corpus`.
- CI check-runs are the PR's own.

## Live reading

Evidence branch `claude/issue-12725e-evidence` (`917af6f8`), `evidence/12725e/`: screenshots at 1010 and 1280 px, before (`32b492b6`) and after (`111d6816`), the DOM readings as JSON, and the driver. Published backend 18.0.0-next.3 (showcase); the copilot's chat stream and the `_drafts` ledger are played by the driver (the community backend serves no agent): the tool answers `drafted` with cloud#2924's envelope shape, then the agent narrates for 20 s.

| run | 2.5 s after the tool answered, turn still running | turn ended | first ledger read after the tool answered |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| before 1280 / 1010 | no badge, no header line | badge 2, no header line | 20.1 s later, about 0.1 s after the turn ended |
| after 1280 / 1010 | badge 2, 「草稿 · 2 项未发布」 | badge 2, line | 0.63 s / 0.65 s later, while the agent was still narrating |

No reload and no navigation in any run. At 1010 px the header chip folds to its pencil glyph (objectui#12611), its text in the tooltip.

## Acceptance notes

- **Overlap with objectui#12724.** Its phase 2 claim names `AiChatPage.tsx` "only for labels it passes"; it landed as PR #12947 before this branch merged `main`, and touched no line of this file. This change is the authoring-emit effect only.
- **Pulse cost.** The pulse now fires once per authoring result instead of once per authoring turn. It is the same pulse (every mounted `MetadataProvider` re-reads its loaded types, the Studio rails re-read); a turn with several authoring calls sends several, spaced by the agent's own calls.
- **Not in this change, reported to the seat:** an in-turn `published` result (cloud's `maybeAutoPublish`, which promotes every pending draft of the package) sends no pulse, so the badge keeps the swept drafts; at 1010 px the copilot's chat panel overflows its 300 px slot once the thread holds a message. Both are in the report.
- **Not this phase:** item 4 (change card v2) and objectui#12894, after objectui#12724.
